references.text: The prophecy about God's servant who will suffer and then see the light and be satisfied can be seen as a foreshadowing of Jesus' suffering and his subsequent glory in the kingdom of God.
The cup of salvation mentioned here may be connected with Jesus' refusal to drink from the vine until he drinks it anew in the kingdom of God.
Jesus' words about not drinking from the vine until he drinks it anew with his disciples in the Father's kingdom parallel Mark 14:25.
Similar to Jesus' promise in Mark 14:25 about not drinking from the vine until he drinks it anew in the kingdom of God.
